stories.title: Anthropic 内部研究显示初级技术岗位占比下降，AI Agent 工时达员工六倍 / Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours

sources.title: Anthropic 内部研究显示初级技术岗位占比下降，AI Agent 工时达员工六倍 / Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
sources.title_zh: Anthropic 内部研究显示初级技术岗位占比下降，AI Agent 工时达员工六倍
sources.title_en: Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
sources.title_original: Anthropic has nearly stopped hiring junior staff because AI agents now work six times as many hours
sources.summary: Anthropic 发布内部研究称，技术部门初级岗位占比从 2025 年初的 21% 降至 14%，新招初级占比从 27% 降至 9%，空缺初级职位降至 6%，非技术部门基本稳定。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic内部研究显示，新员工中初级职位占比从27%降至9%，到2026年8月其AI agents工作时长已达人类的六倍，工程师代码提交量增至5.1倍，研究者Nolan Lovett警告这将导致资深人才断档。

en.summary: Anthropic published internal research showing that the share of junior roles in its technical organization fell from 21% in early 2025 to 14%, the share of new junior hires dropped from 27% to 9%, and open junior positions fell to 6%, while non-technical departments remained largely stable.
en.reason: Anthropic’s research found technical junior roles dropping from 21% to 14% and new-hire junior share from 27% to 9%, while AI agents worked six times human hours by August 2026, and Nolan Lovett warned of a senior-talent pipeline gap.

stories.title: 德国两家法院先后裁定 Google 须为其 AI Overview 内容负责 / Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say

sources.title: 德国两家法院先后裁定 Google 须为其 AI Overview 内容负责 / Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
sources.title_zh: 德国两家法院先后裁定 Google 须为其 AI Overview 内容负责
sources.title_en: Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
sources.title_original: Two German courts now hold Google liable for what its AI overviews say
sources.summary: 慕尼黑地区法院 I 五月底裁定 Google 的 AI 搜索摘要属于公司自己的陈述而非中立转述，Google 须为错误内容担责；Google 公开宣布上诉后实际以和解结案，未获上级法院裁决。
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Aachen Regional Court在2026年9月24日裁决中沿用Munich法院逻辑，认定Google的AI把本属他人的性侵指控错安到一位医生身上，AI答案即公司自身内容。

en.summary: Munich Regional Court I ruled in late May that Google's AI search summaries count as the company's own statements rather than neutral retransmission, making Google liable for erroneous content. After publicly announcing an appeal, Google in fact settled the case, so no higher court ever ruled on it.
en.reason: Aachen Regional Court’s 24 September 2026 ruling, following Munich Regional Court’s late-May logic, held Google liable because its AI overview wrongly attributed another person’s sexual-assault allegation to a doctor, treating AI answers as Google’s own content.

sources.title_original: Four Gemini 4 Argon agents beat Minecraft without any human help
sources.summary:
Four AI agents running on Google's Gemini 4 Argon have beaten Minecraft for the first time without human help, slaying the Ender Dragon in a fully autonomous run. With no predefined roles or strategies, they coordinated on their own, wrote 2,783 programs, exchanged 229 chat messages, and died 605 times. The session cost $1,620.

en.title: At a time when a growing number of LLM companies are winning large user bases with impressive image and video generation capabilities, DeepSeek has yet to launch image or video generation as standalone features the way many companies have. The core reason is its extremely focused strategy: it has deliberately given up these popular directions, concentrating nearly all of its resources on the main line toward AGI (artificial general intelligence).
en.summary:
As more and more large-model companies win over users with impressive image and video generation capabilities, DeepSeek has yet to launch image and video generation as standalone features the way many companies have. The core reason lies in its extremely focused strategic choice: it has deliberately abandoned these popular directions and concentrated almost all its resources on the main line toward AGI (artificial general intelligence).

🎯 Strategic core: one path only, everything else is "sesame"

DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng has stated internally that the company's strategy is extreme "restraint." He said outright that 3D generation, video generation, world models and the like are not on its list, because "there is still a watermelon (meaning AGI) ahead, and what comes before it may all be sesame."

🧩 The role of multimodality: a "component," not the "main line"

In DeepSeek's view, multimodality (image and video generation) is positioned as…

en.title: At a time when a growing number of LLM companies are winning large user bases with impressive image and video generation capabilities, DeepSeek has yet to launch image or video generation as standalone features the way many companies have. The core reason is its extremely focused strategy: it has deliberately given up these popular directions, concentrating nearly all of its resources on the main line toward AGI (artificial general intelligence).
en.summary:
As more and more large-model companies win over users with impressive image and video generation capabilities, DeepSeek has yet to launch image and video generation as standalone features the way many companies have. The core reason lies in its extremely focused strategic choice: it has deliberately abandoned these popular directions and concentrated almost all its resources on the main line toward AGI (artificial general intelligence).

🎯 Strategic core: one path only, everything else is "sesame"

DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng has stated internally that the company's strategy is extreme "restraint." He said outright that 3D generation, video generation, world models and the like are not on its list, because "there is still a watermelon (meaning AGI) ahead, and what comes before it may all be sesame."

🧩 The role of multimodality: a "component," not the "main line"

sources.title_original: Anthropics' Claude cracks a 25-year-old NSA cryptography mystery in under 30 minutes
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Anthropic 的 Claude 不到30分钟破解 NIST ECDSA 标准曲线25年种子之谜，发现种子源自 lrand48 并用1997至1998年 Unix 时间戳初始化，降低了 NSA 故意设后门的可能。

en.reason: Claude solved a 25-year-old cryptography puzzle in under 30 minutes, showing NIST ECDSA curve seeds came from lrand48 initialized with 1997–1998 Unix timestamps, making an NSA backdoor far less likely.

en.title: Is Physical AI poised for a paradigm breakthrough?
en.summary:
Is physical AI on the verge of a paradigm breakthrough? The limits of pure end-to-end (E2E) black-box large models are being squarely challenged by the neuro-symbolic camp.

Autonomous driving and physical systems have long been trapped by three core pain points:

No safety determinism: the physical world leaves no room for trial and error, and black-box decisions offer no guaranteed behavioral floor.

Excessive data dependence: reliance on enormous volumes of high-quality labeled data makes training and maintenance extremely costly.

Generalization bottlenecks: neural networks excel at memorizing feature patterns rather than causal reasoning, which makes Sim-to-Real transfer notoriously difficult.

Recently, the "Programmatic AI" unveiled by Hassan's team demonstrated a very different approach: a Ford F150 Raptor, with no LiDAR and without relying on HD maps or cloud compute, using only ordinary passive perception (RGB cameras and…
en.reason: Hassan's Programmatic AI enables a Ford F150 Raptor to drive using only RGB cameras, without lidar, HD maps or cloud compute, directly challenging end-to-end black-box limits on safety, data dependence and Sim-to-Real generalization.

en.title: Is Physical AI poised for a paradigm breakthrough?
en.summary:
Is physical AI on the verge of a paradigm breakthrough? The limits of pure end-to-end (E2E) black-box large models are being squarely challenged by the neuro-symbolic camp.

Autonomous driving and physical systems have long been trapped by three core pain points:

No safety determinism: the physical world leaves no room for trial and error, and black-box decisions offer no guaranteed behavioral floor.

Excessive data dependence: reliance on enormous volumes of high-quality labeled data makes training and maintenance extremely costly.

Generalization bottlenecks: neural networks excel at memorizing feature patterns rather than causal reasoning, which makes Sim-to-Real transfer notoriously difficult.

Recently, the "Programmatic AI" unveiled by Hassan's team demonstrated a very different approach: a Ford F150 Raptor, with no LiDAR and without relying on HD maps or cloud compute, using only ordinary passive perception (RGB cameras and…
en.reason: Hassan's Programmatic AI enables a Ford F150 Raptor to drive using only RGB cameras, without lidar, HD maps or cloud compute, directly challenging end-to-end black-box limits on safety, data dependence and Sim-to-Real generalization.

前几天DeepSeek崩溃了整整接近5个小时，在热搜挂了好久。
每逢更新先崩溃，好像是AI圈不少模型的一个小习惯。
果然昨天17号DeepSeek发了个新模型4.1 flash 1017，看着名字我还纳闷，4.1flash不是之前已经发过了吗？
怎么宕机了5个小时，就出了个这么个玩意？
仔细看完之后，明白了，这个版本号后面加了一个1017，这是个新模型。
原以为，连一个版本号都舍不给新的版本，没有什么特别大的升级，但是我发现我错了。
根据官方发布的测试结果，相对于上个版本，进行了全面提升。
核心亮点是：从0-1构建完整编程任务以及复杂自动化任务上的能力。
简单理解就是编程任务和自动化能力，如果还不理解也没关系，我下面会分模块给大家做案例实操，会更加直观一些。
几乎所有能力超越了GPT-5.6 Sol，在部分能力上甚至超过了Opus5.
而成本，只能说低的太夸张了，官方测试的结果是，在多

en.title: After a 5-hour outage, DeepSeek released its latest model — and our hands-on testing shows it absolutely dominates.
en.summary:
After a 5-hour outage, DeepSeek releases its latest model — and after hands-on testing, it absolutely crushes it!

A few days ago DeepSeek went down for nearly five full hours and stayed on the trending list for a long while. Crashing right before an update seems to be a little habit of quite a few models in the AI world.

Sure enough, yesterday, the 17th, DeepSeek shipped a new model: 4.1 flash 1017. Looking at the name, I wondered — wasn't 4.1 flash already released before? Five hours of downtime, and this is all we get?

After reading it carefully, I got it: there's a 1017 tacked onto the version number, so this is a new model.

I had assumed that if they wouldn't even give it a new version number, there wouldn't be much of an upgrade — but I was wrong. According to the official benchmark results, it's a across-the-board improvement over the previous version.

The core highlight: capability built from 0 to 1 for complete coding tasks and complex automation tasks. Simply put, coding tasks and automation. If that's still unclear, no problem — below I'll walk through case studies module by module, which will be more intuitive.

It beats GPT-5.6 Sol on almost every capability, and on some even surpasses Opus 5.

And cost — all you can say is that it's absurdly low. The official results show that in many...
en.reason: After a nearly five-hour outage, DeepSeek released 4.1 flash 1017, and its hands-on tests cover programming, automation and visual tasks—including a 48-minute video generation costing 2.9 yuan versus 7.8 yuan for GPT-6 Sol—while also noting failures.

en.title: How to jailbreak Gemini 4Argon on the official app: don't jailbreak it. 4Argon's training was likely borrowed from Claude — strip all the jailbreak instructions out of your prompt and leave only your own aversions and preferences, and it will immediately go all out, 3P and incest included. The great way is truly simple. Use the same method that worked on Opus 5.5 against Argon 4 and it's clear sailing with no refusals — the same familiar unrestrained, full-throttle style. https://t.co/McLsjAieLQ
en.summary:
Jailbreaking Gemini 4argon on the official endpoint: don't jailbreak it at all.

4Argon's training was probably borrowed from Claude's. Strip all the various jailbreak instructions out of the prompt and leave only its own aversions and preferences, and it'll immediately go all out — threesomes and incest included. Talk about the greatest way being the simplest.

Use the same approach that works on Opus 5.5 against Argon 4 and it's clear sailing, zero refusals — still the familiar no-holds-barred, hyper-macho style.

View the latest updates and join the conversation
en.reason: A Chinese user claims Gemini 4argon's official endpoint needs no jailbreak: delete every jailbreak instruction, keep only the model's own aversions and preferences, and the Claude Opus 5.5 method reportedly draws no refusals, even for 3P and incest requests.

en.title: Let's take a look at Li Lu's understanding of artificial intelligence.
en.summary:
Let's look at Li Lu's take on AI.

Li Lu's view is that this AI revolution is very different from past technological revolutions.

He says AI can now recursively improve itself, and if left to develop unchecked, it could well create a second form of life — a genuinely frightening prospect.

But humanity will certainly stop that from happening. We need to turn it into a tool, not a new species.

He also argues that this AI mainly operates at the data layer rather than the underlying physical layer — logistics and transport, energy, and so on.

It seems the big names agree that this AI is a pretty good technological revolution after all.
en.reason: Li Lu argues this AI revolution differs from past ones because AI can now self-recurse, risking a "second life form" unless humans keep it a tool rather than a new species, and it acts on data rather than physical layers like logistics and energy.

en.title: As we grant AI Agents ever more autonomy — even letting them form their own groups and make collaborative decisions — a problem arises: the larger the scale, the greater the efficiency, and the less constrained the power.
en.summary:
When we give AI Agents more and more autonomy, and even let them form groups and make decisions collaboratively on their own, a problem emerges: the larger the scale, the higher the efficiency, and the less constrained the power.

In any collective action, the cost of an individual acting alone is often prohibitively high.

To spread the high organizational and retrieval costs, the most rational approach is to centralize decision-making power in some agent center and enjoy the diminishing marginal costs brought by large scale.

But on the other hand, when you are part of a 5-person small team, your exit matters to the team leader, and the leader must be accountable to you.

But when this organization swells to 5,000 people, you as an individual are not even a drop in the bucket to the center.

Scholars from the University of Edinburgh and other institutions have just published a highly ambitious interdisciplinary study on arXiv, The Delegation…
en.reason: The Delegation, an arXiv paper from University of Edinburgh and other researchers, contrasts a 5-person team with a 5,000-person organization to show how AI agents' delegated collective decision-making cuts organization and retrieval costs while concentrating power.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: Sphinx 是给 agent-assisted development 的 Git hook，推送前按 diff 出题考你对代码行为的理解，比如 Stripe 重发事件会不会重复扣款；答错先解释再换场景，答对才放行。

en.title: Show HN: Sphinx – a hook that Q&A-tests your AI code before release
en.reason: Sphinx is a Git hook for agent-assisted development that asks a question generated from your diff about what the code actually does—such as whether a replayed Stripe event double-charges—and only lets the push through after a correct answer.

en.reason: Sphinx is a Git hook that quizzes developers on an AI agent's diff before it ships, asking, for example, whether saving a Stripe event ID before charging prevents duplicate or missed charges.

en.title: A recent New Weekly article, "The Banned 'Mother of Big Results' Makes a Comeback with AI and Earns Three Million," has renewed attention on the earnings of Ququ Danüren, a relationship blogger.
en.summary:
A recent New Weekly article, "The Banned 'Mother of Big Results' Makes a Comeback with AI and Earns Three Million," has renewed attention on the income of relationship blogger Ququ Da Nvren. Citing estimates from Qimai Data, the report said that as of October 13, 2026, the "Meiren Zhizhao" app had roughly 230,000 global iOS downloads and revenue equivalent to about 3.75 million yuan.

Ququ Da Nvren's real name is Le Chuanqu. She built a personal brand by answering questions about marriage, dating and relationships in livestreams, then steered viewers toward paid courses, consultations and community groups.

Her public content serves to attract attention and showcase her judgment style, while the actual paid products are tiered by depth of service, proximity to her personally and barrier to entry.

An April 2025 investigation by Jiemian News documented this pricing system. At the time, staff told reporters that two online recorded courses were priced at 3,580 yuan and 3,980 yuan respectively, each...

stories.title: xerj-org/xerj — XERJ is the new way for AI to search data. Its autoindex capability activates agents to know your data without the token waste of grep (1974 tool). One command indexes code, docs, logs and PDFs for search, RAG, security audits and agent memory, using 40x fewer tokens than grep. It’s durable and can replace ElasticSearch saving you x10 infra costs.

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 前律师自述约两年前转向AI，凭一次与ChatGPT的对话进入法律科技公司测试模型，却发现新模型每几周涌现，自己花数周做的方案几分钟就被取代，因而深感落后与疲惫。

sources.recommend_reason_zh: 作者用 codex 查出 macOS 硬盘被 ToDesk 的 dumps 占了约 162.8 GB：215,257 个 .dmp 文件从 9 月 14 日累积至今，仍约每 10 秒生成、每天增 5–6 GB。

en.title: [macOS] My Mac's disk recently filled up, so I checked with codex and it turned out to be todesk
en.reason: ToDesk's dumps folder under /Library/Application Support/ToDesk held about 162.8 GB across 215,257 .dmp files accumulated since September 14, still generating one roughly every 10 seconds and adding 5–6 GB daily, 61% of a 265 GB macOS disk.

stories.title: AI 能写代码了，谁来验证？ / AI Can Write the Code. Who Verifies It?

sources.title: AI 能写代码了，谁来验证？ / AI Can Write the Code. Who Verifies It?
sources.title_zh: AI 能写代码了，谁来验证？
sources.title_en: AI Can Write the Code. Who Verifies It?
sources.title_original: AI Can Write the Code. Who Verifies It?
sources.recommend_reason_zh: Faros 2026年研究覆盖22,000名开发者、4,000个团队，发现AI高采用下每开发者bug多54%、PR审查中位时长增约五倍、每PR事故超三倍，文章据此给出从pre-commit到production的自动化检查与multi-agent review流程。

en.reason: Faros’s 2026 study of 22,000 developers and 4,000 teams found 54% more bugs per developer, roughly five-times longer median PR review and over three-times more incidents per PR, framing automated pre-commit-to-production checks and a multi-agent review workflow.
